claim_limitation: This bounded userspace protocol validates the metrics-v7 conditioned coordination and policy lifecycle telemetry pipeline only. It does not establish kernel scheduler compliance, a causal scheduler-performance improvement, or a CPU-capacity effect.
aggregation_unit: invocation; rows are repeated observations within an invocation and are not independent experimental repetitions
effective_action_scope: S2_effective and action-specific fractions remain conservative observable userspace action-attempt measurements, not Linux dispatch compliance.
burst_metric_scope: S4_burst is an experimental selected-action burst diagnostic. v7 exposes conditioned S3 and uses min(historical S4, S4_burst) for the canonical S4 field; Q remains the geometric mean of the emitted S1-S4 factors.
policy_scope: Policy mode, generation, persistence, and suppression fields describe the userspace policy lifecycle; they are not kernel controller state.
schema_compatibility_note: v2 through v7 observations must not be silently pooled. v7 is append-only relative to the strict 120-column v6 contract and adds coordination_semantics_version=7.
protocol_notes: The runner must preserve stdout CSV, stderr, environment, validation report, and metadata for successful, failed, timed-out, and interrupted invocations.
The runner must validate the explicit orchestra.paper_cpu.metrics/v7 identifier and strict 121-column header before summary generation.
The runner must summarize invocations, not individual CSV rows, and must include conditioned S3, burst-sensitive S4, historical factors, and policy lifecycle diagnostics.

The campaign is a bounded data-pipeline and deterministic-metric validation. Natural host action traces need not contain a controller degradation; synthetic deterministic unit or integration scenarios provide the required semantic coverage.
No invocation uses SCHED_FIFO or requires root privileges.
